parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit corrects all identified error targets: it removes the score-mapping error by no longer concluding with score 3, fixes the rubric misapplication by rejecting the demand for unnecessary sub-aspect enumeration, corrects the unsupported inference about authors not knowing what to include, and reframes the conclusion to describe rubric-relevant qualities without stating a numeric score or gold label. The corrected rationale preserves the valid initial observation that the comment contains an explicit action and is internally coherent.
